{{Otheruses|Scarlet}}
{{Quote|What song, written and performed by the band Starburst, was rated Scarlet (artistically worthless and offensive) by the Imperial Board of Culture?|The Theed Palace librarian, quizzing a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Scarlet''' was a term used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|COMPNOR]] [[Art (COMPNOR)/Legends|Art]] Divsion for artistic pieces, whether holodramas, music or art, that did not meet approval from Imperial censors. These artistic pieces were considered worthless, offensive, dangerous, or anti-Imperial.

As a result, it led to the term "drawing a scarlet", and such a work would enjoy commercial success on dozens of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]].<ref name="ISB SB">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
